original.target_description: Experiment 2: current mood worsening during anticipation versus retrospection of menstruation

n.quote: We excluded 2 participants from the analyses: one who did not report her current emotion and one who did not report how unpleasant her previous period was (resulting N⫽49).
n.exclusions: Two of 51 excluded: missing current emotion or previous-period unpleasantness.

replication.target_description: Menstruation: influence of contemplation on current mood (DV1)

n.sample_role: participants by anticipation and retrospection condition, respectively; printed group counts
n.exclusions: General funneling removed two participants unable to mentally time travel and two unable to write about a scenario (p. 38). Main results explicitly described as pre-exclusion on p. 37; subsequent supplementary exclusions are not applied to these printed tests.

reported_success.quote: we found empirical support for the past-future emotional asymmetry hypothesis in menstruation and vacation

notes: Extracted by neutral outcome description; supplied replication page locators interchange current emotion (DV1, p. 40) and predicted/remembered emotion (DV2, p. 41). No values converted. Replication main tables report pre-exclusion analyses, apart from general funneling.
